description: The zones a DNS provider lists for a credential

supported.description: False when the provider of the credential has no zone list; nothing was asked of any outside service then

truncated.description: True when the provider has more than 1000 zones and only the first 1000 are listed

state.description: `here`: already a domain of this credential. `other`: a domain of another credential of the same owner. `new`: not stored yet

credential_name.description: The name of the other credential that has the domain, only with state `other`
